# dsh-unity-mcp-bridge
中文 → README.zh.md
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that bridges a Unity MCP server (`com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp` / AI Gam
e Developer) into DSH. It stays dormant until you ask for Unity.
## Intro

- Dormant from boot: no connection, no Unity tools — two hook tools, ~224 tokens.
- `/unity-mcp-tool

s` then `unity_mcp_activate` connects and registers `mcp__unity__*`.
- Enabled commands take effect

on the **next** step; `unity_tools_restore` disables them and disconnects.
- Ships the command catal
og for plugin 1.6.0 (19 commands, RQL-first; regenerable from the offline package via `/unity-mcp-up
date-tools`) and the `/unity-mcp-install` / `/unity-mcp-delete` / `/unity-mcp-check` / `/unity-mcp-u

pdate` / `/unity-mcp-update-tools` skills.
- `resyncAfterTools`: after a management-tool call the br
idge re-fetches `tools/list` itself, because DSH's long-lived session never receives `list_changed`.

Override the row only when this profile uses a different endpoint, in `%DSH_HOME%/profiles/<profile>

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-unity-mcp-bridge`
## Usage
| Entry | What it does |
| `/unity-mcp-install` | Installs the Unity-side plugin and the MCP Server into the workspace's Unit

y project |
| `/unity-mcp-delete` | Uninstalls the Unity-MCP plugin and its extensions, cleaning con

fig and cache leftovers |
| `/unity-mcp-check` | Checks plugin install, port 20000, DSH bundle loadi

ng, minimal tool set and catalog version, then runs the connect test |
| `/unity-mcp-update` | Check
s the official CLI, the local `vendor/` offline package and the Unity plugin for updates; upgrades o

nly after you agree |
| `/unity-mcp-update-tools` | Refreshes the offline package and regenerates th

e `/unity-mcp-tools` command and extension indexes |
| `/unity-mcp-tools` | Opens Unity capability:

activate → find the command → enable only what the task needs |
| `unity_tools_restore` | Disables e
verything except the management tool and returns to dormant |
Everything else — configuration fields, the offline `vendor/` package, catalog regeneration, self-te
st — is in docs/DETAILS.md; measured feature comparison in FEATURES-AND-COMPARISON.md.
